blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Learning visual policies requires turning interaction experience into guidance for individual decisions. Trajectory outcomes obscure action quality, while unguided exploration can revisit familiar situations. We present \textsc{LightAct}, an experience-learning framework that connects skill-guided exploration with policy internalization. Interaction segments are summarized into experience entries and consolidated into a game-specific skill that guides root collection toward broader state coverage. At each root, candidate actions are compared through short rollouts under a shared frozen policy. Environment-reported score gains are averaged across continuations and normalized into relative action rewards, producing reusable supervision for reinforcement learning. Policy training uses a compact dataset of just 1,024 decision roots collected in a single source game and paired with their action rewards. Across 170 GameWorld tasks spanning 34 games, \textsc{LightAct} improves overall progress by 23.6, 29.2, and 13.0 percentage points at the 2B, 4B, and 9B scales, respectively, with our strongest model competitive with reported proprietary-model results. Ablations show broader root-state coverage with skill guidance and consistent gains across three policy optimizers. Case studies show how rollouts distinguish actions with identical immediate gains.
blocks.zh: 学习视觉政策需要将互动经验转化为个人决策的指导。 轨迹结果模糊了行动质量,而无指导的探索可以重新审视熟悉的情况。 我们提出\textsc{Light Act},这是一个经验学习框架,将技术指导探索与政策内化联系起来。 互动部分被归纳为经验条目,并被整合为一种针对游戏的技能,指导根集向更广泛的国家覆盖. 在每个方面,通过根据共同冻结政策短时间推出来比较候选人的行动。 环境报告得分收益在续作中平均,并正常化为相对行动奖励,从而产生可重复使用的强化学习监督。 政策培训使用一套紧凑的数据集,其中只有1 024个决策根源在单一源游戏中收集,并与其动作奖励相配. 超过170个GameWorld的任务涵盖34个游戏,\textsc{LightAct}将总体进度分别提高23.6,29.2和13.0个百分点的2B,4B,9B等尺度,我们最强的模型与所报告的专有模型结果竞争. 三个政策优化者在技能指导和持续收益方面表现出更广泛的根态覆盖。 案例研究显示,推出行动如何区分具有相同直接收益的行动。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly serve as agents that connect visual perception and language reasoning to action in interactive environments [ 31 , 32 , 25 , 14 ] . Video games expose the demands of this process: an agent must recognize the current situation, choose an executable move, and adapt as its actions change the environment [ 17 , 16 , 9 ] . Interaction also provides experience from which to improve. Prior work retains such experience as contextual guidance [ 29 , 21 ] or uses it to update policy parameters through reinforcement learning [ 1 , 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)日益成为将视觉感知和语言推理与互动环境中的行动联系起来的代理人[31,32,25,14]. 电子游戏揭露了这个过程的要求:一个代理商必须承认当前的情况,选择可执行的动作,并随着其动作改变环境而适应[17,16,9]. 互动也提供了改进的经验。 先前的工作保留了背景指导[29、21]等经验,或通过强化学习更新政策参数[1、8]。

blocks.en: The central challenge is to turn this experience into guidance about individual decisions. A trajectory records the actions taken and their realized outcomes, leaving alternatives at the same decision point unobserved [ 24 ] . Its final outcome combines many choices: a useful move can be followed by a mistake, while a poor move can be rescued later. Environment scores summarize these outcomes, but do not directly reveal which action would have been preferable at a particular state [ 18 ] . The states encountered during exploration introduce a second limitation. Repeatedly visiting familiar situations concentrates experience on a narrow range of decisions [ 5 , 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 中心挑战是将这一经验转化为对个别决定的指导。 轨迹记录了所采取的行动及其已实现的结果,使替代品在同一个决定点无法观察[24]。 其最终结果结合了许多选择:一个有用的动作可以被错误所接踵而来,而一个糟糕的动作可以被后来挽救. 环境分数总结了这些结果,但并不直接显示哪些行动在某一特定状态中是可取的[18]. 在勘探过程中遇到的国家引入了第二个限制。 反复访问熟悉的情况,将经验集中于范围狭窄的决定[5、15]。

blocks.en: These observations suggest organizing experience around both the states reached and the choices available there. Summaries of prior interaction can guide exploration toward a broader set of decision states. At a selected state, executing alternative actions under a shared continuation policy makes their subsequent outcomes comparable. Averaging score gains over short rollouts then yields an estimate of each action’s value, which can be converted into supervision for policy learning.
blocks.zh: 这些意见表明,围绕所达到的州和那里现有的选择组织经验。 以往互动摘要可指导探索,以形成更广泛的决策状态。 在选定的国家,根据共同延续政策执行替代行动使随后的结果具有可比性。 然后对每项行动的价值作出估计,然后将其转化为政策学习的监督。

blocks.en: We present LightAct , an experience-learning framework that combines skill-guided exploration with policy internalization . We partition preliminary trajectories collected by a frozen pretrained VLM into short interaction segments. The model summarizes each segment into an experience entry describing the observed conditions, behavior, and outcome, then consolidates these entries into a game-specific textual skill. The skill guides subsequent exploration by providing reusable advice on effective behavior and recurring failures. We retain distinct visited states and their visual decision contexts as a bank of decision roots.
blocks.zh: 将技术指导探索与政策内化相结合。 我们把一个被冷冻的预先训练的 VLM 收集到的初步轨迹分成短的相互作用段。 模型将每个部分归纳成一个经验条目,描述观察到的条件,行为,以及结果,然后将这些条目合并为游戏特有的文字技能. 该技能通过就有效行为和再生失败提供可重复使用的建议来指导后续探索. 我们保留了不同的受访国家及其作为决策根源库的视觉决策背景。

blocks.en: At each root, we compare the available actions through repeated short continuations under the same frozen policy. The resulting environment-reported score gains are averaged and normalized within the root to produce relative action rewards. Pairing these rewards with the collected decision contexts forms a fixed training set. Reinforcement learning then updates the policy by sampling responses to these contexts and assigning rewards to their parsed actions.
blocks.zh: 在每一个根源上,我们通过在同一冻结政策下重复的短暂延续来比较现有的行动。 由此产生的环境报告得分收益在根基中平均并正常化,以产生相对的行动奖励。 将这些奖励与所收集的决定背景相匹配,构成了一套固定的培训。 强化学习之后,通过对这些背景的反应进行抽样并奖励其分析的行动来更新政策。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : A 2048 decision by LightAct -2B. When repeated downward moves no longer change the board, the policy switches to moving right and gains 24 points.
blocks.zh: 图2:2048年Light Act -2B决定。 当反复向下移动不再改变棋盘时,政策切换为向右移动并增加24分.

blocks.en: We instantiate LightAct at the 2B, 4B, and 9B scales using Qwen3.5 [ 19 ] and evaluate on all 170 GameWorld tasks across 34 games and five categories [ 16 ] . With experience collected in 2048, overall progress improves by 23.6, 29.2, and 13.0 percentage points at the three scales, respectively. LightAct -2B reaches 36.9% progress and 13.9% success, exceeding the pretrained 9B baseline on both metrics, while LightAct -9B achieves 41.8% progress, competitive with reported proprietary-model results. Further experiments show broader root-state coverage with skill guidance, gains across three RL optimizers, and benefits from source-game experience across game categories. Qualitative examples illustrate how rollout comparisons reveal action preferences that immediate gains alone cannot distinguish.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 Quen3.5 [19] 在 2B, 4B, 和 9B 的平面上用 . . . . . 根据2048年收集的经验,三个比额表的总体进展分别提高了23.6%、29.2%和13.0%。 LightAct -2B达到了36.9%的进步和13.9%的成功率,超过了两个度量衡上经过预先训练的9B基线,而LightAct -9B则达到了41.8%的进步率,与所报告的专有模式结果相竞争. 进一步的实验显示更广阔的根态覆盖,拥有技能指导,3个RL优化器的增益,以及不同游戏类的源游戏体验所带来的好处. 定性实例说明推出比较如何显示仅靠直接收益无法区分的行动偏好。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce an experience-learning framework that connects skill-guided source exploration with reinforcement learning from action-level feedback. • We construct reusable action-reward tables by comparing continuations from shared decision roots under a frozen policy and normalizing their environment-reported score gains. • We demonstrate improvements across three model scales on GameWorld and examine how skill guidance, source environments, and policy optimizers contribute to learning from interaction.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 我们采用一个经验学习框架,将技能指导源的探索与从行动层面反馈中加强学习联系起来。 我们通过比较冻结政策下共同决策根的延续情况并实现环境报告得分的正常化,构建可重复使用的行动奖励表。 我们展示了GameWorld三个模型尺度的改进,并审查了技能指导、源环境和政策优化者如何从互动中学习。

blocks.en: We introduce an experience-learning framework that connects skill-guided source exploration with reinforcement learning from action-level feedback.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一个经验学习框架,将技能指导源的探索与从行动层面反馈中强化学习联系起来。

blocks.en: We construct reusable action-reward tables by comparing continuations from shared decision roots under a frozen policy and normalizing their environment-reported score gains.
blocks.zh: 我们通过比较冻结政策下共同决策根源的延续情况并实现环境报告得分的正常化,构建可重复使用的行动奖励表。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Vision-Language Game Agents
blocks.zh: 2.1 远景语言 游戏代理商

blocks.en: Video games test whether visual understanding supports sequential decisions [ 36 ] . Cradle [ 25 ] combines perception, planning, and memory to operate through screenshots and keyboard or mouse controls. BALROG [ 17 ] evaluates language and vision-language agents across games and reveals weaknesses in visually grounded interaction. VideoGameBench [ 34 ] examines play from raw visual input under real-time and paused interaction, separating decision quality from the effects of inference latency. GameWorld [ 16 ] provides browser games with standardized interfaces and state-verifiable task evaluation. Complementing these benchmarks, lmgame-Bench [ 8 ] studies perception and memory scaffolds and reports that reinforcement learning on individual games can transfer beyond the training environment. Our work examines how source-game interaction supports such policy learning.
blocks.zh: 电子游戏测试视觉理解是否支持相继决定 [36]. Cradle [25]结合了感知,规划和内存,通过截图和键盘或鼠标控制来操作. BALROG [17] 在整个游戏中评价语言和视觉语言代理,并揭示视觉基础互动中的弱点. VideoGame Bench [34] 在实时和暂停互动下从原始视觉输入中检查玩法,将决策质量与推论后置效应区分开来. GameWorld [16] 为浏览器游戏提供标准化界面和状态可验证的任务评价. 作为这些基准的补充,lmgame-Bench [8] 研究感知和记忆脚手架,并报告说,对单个游戏的强化学习可以转移出训练环境. 我们的工作审查了源游戏互动如何支持这种政策学习。

blocks.en: 2.2 Experience Learning of VLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2 志愿活动经验学习

blocks.en: VLM agents learn from accumulated interaction through contextual guidance and parameter updates. External memory retains experience for retrieval at decision time [ 13 ] , while parameter updates encode it in the policy [ 6 ] . JARVIS-1 [ 29 ] retrieves multimodal Minecraft experience to support planning, while ELITE [ 30 ] extracts reusable strategies from trajectories and retrieves them according to task intent. ICAL [ 21 ] refines suboptimal demonstrations through execution and human feedback, annotating causal relations, state changes, and subgoals; the resulting examples support both retrieval and supervised fine-tuning. For reinforcement learning, DigiRL [ 1 ] adapts a pretrained VLM for device control through offline initialization and online interaction, using a VLM evaluator for feedback. VAGEN [ 27 ] improves explicit state estimation and transition prediction in multi-turn visual interaction through reinforcement learning. We connect experience-guided source exploration with policy internalization.
blocks.zh: VLM代理通过上下文引导和参数更新从累积的互动中学习. 外部内存保留了在决定时间[13]检索的经验,而参数更新则在策略中编码[6]. JARVIS-1 [29] 检索多式地雷作业经验以支持规划,而ELITE [30] 从轨迹中提取可重复使用的战略,并根据任务意图取回. ALC[21]通过执行和人类反馈,说明因果关系,状态变化,以及分目标,完善了次优化的演示;由此产生的实例支持检索和监督的微调. 为进行强化学习,DigirRL [1]通过离线初始化和在线交互,对设备控制预加训练的VLM进行调整,使用VLM评价器进行反馈. VAGEN [27]通过强化学习,在多回合视觉互动中改进了明确的状态估计和过渡预测. 我们把经验指导源的探索与政策内化联系起来。

blocks.en: 2.3 Rollout-Based Policy Learning
blocks.zh: 2.3 推出政策学习

blocks.en: Rollouts estimate the value of an action from the outcomes that follow it. Monte Carlo policy improvement compares candidate moves by continuing each with a common base policy [ 26 ] . In combinatorial optimization and stochastic scheduling, heuristic continuations estimate the future cost of each choice [ 3 , 2 ] . Sparse sampling [ 10 ] estimates action values over sampled lookahead trees, while UCT [ 11 ] uses a bandit rule to allocate simulations among branches. Rollout comparisons also provide supervision for policy learning [ 35 ] . Classification-based policy iteration [ 12 ] uses the preferred action at a sampled state as a training label. AggreVaTe [ 20 ] trains on expert cost-to-go estimates, while LOLS [ 4 ] evaluates decisions under both reference and learned policies. For language models, LATS [ 37 ] guides tree search with model evaluations and environment feedback, and Math-Shepherd [ 28 ] uses sampled completions to assess intermediate reasoning steps. We use score gains from a shared game state to supervise action selection.
blocks.zh: " 推出 " 估计从随后的成果中得出一项行动的价值。 蒙特卡洛政策改进通过继续采取每项共同基础政策对候选人流动进行比较[26]。 在组合优化和有条理的日程安排中,heuristic continuation估计了每种选择的未来成本[3,2]. Sparse sample [10] 估计被采样的外观树的动作值,而UCT [11] 则使用强盗规则在分支间分配模拟. 推出比较还为政策学习提供了监督[35]。 基于分级的政策迭接 [12] 使用抽样状态的首选动作作为培训标签. 虾 VaTe [20] 列车进行专家成本对去估算,而LOLS [4] 则根据参考和学到的政策评价决定. 对于语言模型,LATS [37] 以模型评价和环境反馈来指导树搜索,而Math-Shepherd [28] 则使用被抽样的完成来评估中间推理步骤. 我们使用共享游戏状态的分数收益来监督动作选择.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Experience gathered during interaction can guide subsequent decisions through both contextual guidance and policy learning. Building on this view, LightAct (Fig. ) distills source-game trajectories into textual skills for exploration and compares action outcomes at the collected roots to construct action-level rewards for policy internalization.
blocks.zh: 在互动过程中所积累的经验能够通过背景指导和政策学习指导随后的决定。 基于这一看法,LightAct(图.)将源游戏轨迹分解为勘探的文字技能,并比较所收集的根部的行动结果,为政策内化构建出行动层面的奖励.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Overview of LightAct . Interaction segments are summarized into experience entries, then consolidated into a source-game skill that guides root-state collection. At each root, short rollouts compare candidate actions through their subsequent score gains. These gains are normalized into action-level rewards for reinforcement learning, internalizing the collected experience in a policy evaluated across games.
blocks.zh: 图3: 光法概览 交互部分被归纳为经验条目,再被整合为指导根态采集的源游戏技能. 在每个根基上,短幅推出通过候选人随后的得分收益来比较候选人的行动. 这些成果已规范化为强化学习的行动层面奖励,将所收集的经验纳入对各种游戏的评价政策。

blocks.en: 3.1 Decision-Making in Game Environment
blocks.zh: 3.1 游戏环境中的决策

blocks.en: In GameWorld [ 16 ] , an agent pursues a game-specific objective through sequential interaction. At each decision, it receives the game rules, task instruction, role information, and available semantic actions, together with the current screenshot and recent observation–action history. The agent generates a response, parses it into an executable action, observes its effect on the game, and continues toward the objective. This interaction links visual understanding to decisions whose consequences unfold over subsequent steps.
blocks.zh: 在"GameWorld [16]"中,代理通过相继互动追求特定游戏目标. 每次决定时,它都会收到游戏规则,任务指示,角色信息,以及可用的语义动作,以及当前的截图和最近的观察-行动历史. 代理生成一个响应,将其描述为可执行动作,观察其对游戏的影响,并继续向目标前进. 这种互动将视觉理解与决定联系起来,这些决定的后果发生在随后的步骤上。

blocks.en: 3.2 Exploration and Root-State Collection

blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark and Evaluation Setting
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准和评价设置

blocks.en: We evaluate LightAct on GameWorld [ 16 ] , which comprises 34 games and 170 tasks across five categories: Arcade, Platformer, Puzzle, Runner, and Simulation. Each run has a budget of 100 decisions, with the environment paused during inference. At each decision, the policy receives the game instructions, the current screenshot, and two rounds of image–text interaction history, and selects an action from the game’s interface. Action duration, episode termination, and resets follow the protocol. Published GameWorld results use greedy decoding with one run per task. Our Qwen3.5 and LightAct evaluations use temperature 1.0, top- p p 0.95, a 2,048-token output cap, and three runs per task. We use GameWorld’s state-based evaluator to measure success rate (SR), the fraction of successful runs, and progress (PG), normalized completion toward task-specific targets.
blocks.zh: 我们评价GameWorld上的"光行动"[16],它包含34个游戏和170个任务,分为"Arcade","平台","谜题","跑道","模拟"等5个类别. 每次运行都有100个决定的预算,在推论期间环境暂停. 每次决定时,政策都会收到游戏指令,当前截图,以及两轮图像-文本互动历史,并从游戏界面中选择一个动作. 动作持续时间,插曲终止, 和重排遵循协议。 已发布的GameWorld结果使用贪婪的解码,每个任务运行一次. 我们的Quen3.5和LightAct评价使用温度1.0,最高 -- 第0.95页,一个2 048个托肯输出上限,每个任务运行三次. 我们用GameWorld的州评价员来衡量成功率(SR),成功运行的一小部分,以及进展(PG),使完成特定任务的目标正常化。

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节

blocks.en: We instantiate LightAct with Qwen3.5-2B, Qwen3.5-4B, and Qwen3.5-9B [ 19 ] . At each scale, experience collection, branch continuation, and skill extraction use frozen copies of the same model that initializes the trainable policy. Acting uses the native non-thinking mode. For each source game–task pair, we collect trajectories within a budget of 10,000 decisions and retain up to 1,024 deduplicated roots, with seed 42 for the initial reset. We equip source games with snapshot support through exportSnapshot() and importSnapshot() , restoring each decision root before evaluating candidate actions. Collection and branch continuation use temperature 1.0, top- p p 0.95, and a 2,048-token output cap. Branch valuation uses H = 10 H=10 including the initial action and K = 4 K=4 continuations, processing eight roots concurrently. Rewards use environment-reported score gains with per-root min–max normalization. We train with GRPO [ 22 ] , REINFORCE++ [ 7 ] , or DAPO [ 33 ] in verl/HybridFlow [ 23 ] . Tables and in the appendix give the collection and reward settings and the training hyperparameters, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们用Quen3.5-2B,Quen3.5-4B,和Quen3.5-9B[19]来即兴放电. 在每个尺度上,经验收集,分支续作和技能取出都使用被冻结的同一种模式复制来初始化可训练政策. 演技采用本土非思考模式. 每对源游戏任务,我们收集10 000个决策预算范围内的轨迹,并保留多达1 024个被复制的根,初始重置的种子为42。 我们通过导出Snapshot()和导入Snapshot()为源游戏提供快照支持,在评价候选动作前恢复每个决定根 。 采集和分支续用温度1.0,顶端-p.0.95,并有2,048个托肯输出盖. 分行估值采用H=10 H=10,包括初始动作和K=4 K=4续作,同时处理8个根. 奖励使用环境报告得分增益,每分钟实现最大正常化。 我们用GRPO[22],REINFORCE++[7],或DAPO[33]在活字/HybridFlow[23]中进行训练. 表格和附录分别提供了收集和奖励设置和培训超参数。

blocks.en: 4.3 Baselines and Main Comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.3 基线和主要比较

blocks.en: LightAct brings compact policies close to strong proprietary models in benchmark progress (Table ). At 4B, it reaches 40.5% overall PG, comparable to GPT-5.2 at 40.6%; at 9B, it reaches 41.8%, approaching Gemini-3-Flash-Preview at 41.9%. On Puzzle tasks, LightAct -9B achieves 59.2% PG, exceeding the reported progress of both models. The remaining gap is clearer in task completion, where overall SR reaches 18.4% for LightAct -9B compared with 21.2% for Gemini. By comparing actions from a shared state, LightAct turns interaction outcomes into supervision for policy learning. These results suggest that internalizing such experience enables compact VLMs to achieve competitive game-playing performance through direct policy inference.
blocks.zh: Light Act将紧凑的政策带近于有力的专有模式的基准进展(表)。 在4B时,其总的PG值达到40.5%,可与GPT-5.2相媲美,为40.6%;在9B时,可达到41.8%,接近双子座-3-Flash-Preview为41.9%. 在谜题任务上, LightAct - 9B 实现 59.2%的PG,超过了两个模型报告的进展. 余下的差距在任务完成方面更为明显,Light Act -9B的总体SR达到18.4%,而双子座则达到21.2%。 通过比较共同国家的行动,Light Act将互动结果转化为对政策学习的监督. 这些结果表明,将这种经验内部化能够使紧凑的VLM通过直接的政策推论实现有竞争力的游戏玩法表现.

blocks.en: LightAct increases both SR and PG in all five game categories at 2B, 4B, and 9B, indicating benefits for task completion as well as partial progress. The overall PG gains are 23.6, 29.2, and 13.0 percentage points, respectively. The 4B policy gains most on Runner tasks, where PG rises from 8.2% to 49.7%, even though its training experience comes from a puzzle game. Notably, LightAct -2B surpasses the pretrained 9B baseline in both PG (36.9% versus 28.8%) and SR (13.9% versus 10.0%), showing that adaptation through experience can improve the effectiveness of a smaller policy. The 9B model also gains 8.4 percentage points in SR over its initialization, demonstrating that stronger pretrained performance still leaves room for improvement through supervision from interaction.
blocks.zh: LightAct在2B,4B,9B的所有五个游戏类别中都增加了SR和PG,表明任务完成的好处以及部分进展. 石油总收益分别为23.6%、29.2%和13.0%。 4B政策在"跑者"任务上收益最多,其中PG从8.2%上升到49.7%,尽管其培训经验出自一款拼图游戏. 值得注意的是,在PG(36.9%对28.8%)和SR(13.9%对10.0%)中,Light Act-2B超过了预先培训的9B基线,这表明通过经验的适应可以提高较小政策的有效性。 9B模式在斯洛伐克共和国的初始化过程中也提高了8.4个百分点,表明通过互动监督,强化预先训练的绩效仍有改进的余地。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablations and Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 4.4 缺勤和诊断

blocks.en: We compare GRPO, REINFORCE++, and DAPO, using the same reward tables for each model scale (Table ). All nine trained configurations improve overall PG over their base policies, with gains ranging from 10.8 to 29.2 percentage points. This pattern suggests that the action-level rewards provide useful supervision across different policy-update rules. The optimizer still affects how these gains are distributed across games: at 4B, DAPO achieves higher Puzzle and Simulation PG than GRPO, while GRPO attains higher overall PG. Thus, the common benefit of learning from action outcomes persists alongside algorithm-dependent differences in performance across categories.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了GRPO、REINFORCE++和DAPO,对每个模型比额表使用相同的奖励表(表)。 所有九个训练有素的配置都比其基本政策改善了总体公益,收益从10.8%到29.2%不等。 这种模式表明,行动一级的奖励对不同的政策更新规则提供了有益的监督。 优化器仍然会影响这些收益在游戏间的分配方式:在4B,DAPO实现比GRPO更高的谜语和模拟PG,而GRPO则实现更高的总体PG. 因此,从行动成果中学习的共同利益继续存在,同时不同类别的业绩也存在取决于算法的差异。

blocks.en: Figure compares 1,024 roots collected with and without skill guidance in 2048; Figure shows the skill used during collection. By drawing on interaction experience, the skill guides the policy away from repeated ineffective moves and helps it explore a broader range of game states. Guided collection extends the score range from 0–552 to 0–944 and raises the mean score from 186.6 to 280.2. The proportion of roots scoring at least 500 increases from 1.3% to 19.4%, while lower-score states remain represented. With GRPO, skill guidance raises PG from 32.98% to 36.90% and SR from 12.35% to 13.92% (lower panels of Figure ). With REINFORCE++, PG changes little (34.60% to 34.55%), while SR rises from 11.96% to 12.75%. These results suggest that skill guidance broadens the experience available for policy learning, with benefits that depend on the optimizer.
blocks.zh: 对比2048年收集的有和无技能指导的1 024个根;图中显示了收集过程中使用的技能. 通过借鉴互动经验,技能指导政策远离反复无效动作,并帮助其探索更广泛的游戏状态. 指导性收藏将分数从0–552到0–944,将平均分数从186.6提高到280.2. 根分至少500分的比例从1.3%增加到19.4%,而分数较低的州仍然占比。 在GRPO中,技能指导将PG从32.98%提高到36.90%,SR从12.35%提高到13.92%(图中较低面板)。 随着REINFORCE++,PG变化很小(34.60%到34.55%),而SR从11.96%上升到12.75%. 这些结果表明,技能指导扩大了可供政策学习使用的经验,其好处取决于优化者。

blocks.en: With Tetris as the source game, both GRPO and REINFORCE++ improve PG over the 2B base policy across all five categories (Figure ). Arcade PG, for example, rises from 5.6% to 29.8% and 29.6%, respectively. These gains extend beyond the source game’s Puzzle category, suggesting that policy internalization helps LightAct apply experience to different game mechanics. Experience from a single game can provide supervision for broader visual decisions. The varying gains across categories indicate that transfer is uneven, leaving room to improve the breadth of behaviors learned from source experience.
blocks.zh: GRPO和REINFORCE++都是以俄罗斯方块为源游戏 在所有5个类别中改进2B基础政策中的PG(图)。 例如,街机PG从5.6%上升到29.8%和29.6%。 这些收益超越了源游戏的"谜题"类别,暗示了政策内化有助于"光行动"将经验应用于不同的游戏力学. 单一游戏的经验可以为更广泛的视觉决策提供监督. 不同类别之间不同的收益表明,转移是不均衡的,为扩大从源头经验中汲取的行为范围留有余地.

blocks.en: In Figure , moving left or right from the same root yields an immediate score gain of 24, but the resulting boards support different continuations. The rightward branch produces a 64 tile, whereas the leftward branch retains a maximum tile of 32. Across four rollouts, moving right achieves a mean gain of 144 versus 67 for moving left, yielding normalized rewards of 1.000 and 0.330. The rollout comparison turns delayed action outcomes into a training preference that immediate score gains alone cannot provide.
blocks.zh: 在图中,从同根向左或向右移动可立即产生24分的得分收益,但由此产生的板会支持不同的续作. 向右分行出产64瓦,而向左分行则保留了最大为32瓦. 在四次推出过程中,向右移动对左移动的平均收益为144比67,得到1 000和0.330的正常回报。 推出的比较将延迟行动结果转变为培训偏好,而仅靠直接得分收益是无法提供的。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented LightAct , a framework that turns interaction experience into guidance for exploration and supervision for policy learning. Game-specific skills broaden root-state coverage, while short rollouts from shared roots reveal the relative utility of candidate actions. Experiments on GameWorld show consistent improvements across model scales and policy optimizers, with compact policies achieving competitive progress against proprietary models. These findings demonstrate the value of organizing experience around states and action outcomes for learning game-playing policies.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了《光明法案》,这个框架将互动经验转化为探索和监督政策学习的指导。 游戏特有技能拓宽了根态覆盖范围,而从共享根部推出的短片则揭示出候选行动的相对效用. 关于GameWorld的实验显示,在模型尺度和政策优化者之间不断改进,紧凑的政策相对于专有模式取得了竞争进展. 这些调查结果表明了围绕各州组织经验和行动成果对学习游戏游戏政策的价值。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en: Generalization across source environments remains limited, and the current framework does not directly support action spaces with continuous parameters. Our study focuses on short-horizon decisions; long-horizon decision-making remains to be validated. Future work will investigate integration with multi-turn reinforcement learning and evaluation on games that require sustained planning. Reward shaping currently relies on scores read from environment states. We will further explore purely visual self-improvement that derives learning signals from observations without access to internal environment states.
blocks.zh: 跨源环境的通化仍然有限,而目前的框架并不直接支持具有连续参数的行动空间. 我们的研究侧重于短视决定;长视决策仍有待验证。 今后的工作将调查与需要持续规划的游戏的多回合强化学习和评价相结合的情况。 奖励塑造目前依赖于从环境状态读取的分数. 我们将进一步探索纯粹的视觉自我改善,从无法进入内部环境状态的观察中获得学习信号。
